findings: Causal-learn FCI source is pinned to commit 0dacacf and exposes the selected CI tests, alpha, depth, max-path and background-knowledge controls. Its return contract preserves PAG endpoint marks and possible latent-confounder/directness properties; it must not be converted to a DAG by default.

Tigramite snapshots identify LPCMCI as a stationary time-series PAG method and distinguish CI-test assumptions. The saved PCMCI+ implementation records adjacency uncertainty/strength but not contemporaneous directionality. Its GPL-3.0 package metadata and unverified mutable source pin require a separate licensing and reproducibility decision.
The authentic causal-learn paper and Gerhardus--Runge paper support the conceptual package/theory boundaries; package-paper version 0.1.3.8 is kept distinct from selected code 0.1.4.8.

The exact borrower construction reproduces the same observed A,Y table under a direct-effect law and a hidden-readiness law, with stipulated net values USD 5,000 versus USD -1,000 for 100 accounts. It is synthetic proposal evidence, not bank data.
The bounded search reports 61 metadata hits and returns 10. Uninspected candidates and algorithm variants remain omissions; no absence claim is made.
